title: Module Configuration
description: Configuration passed to an intervention module. Tells the module which country, language, message variant, and help services to use.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. NL, DE, GB).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. nl, en, de). Typically from navigator.language.

tone.description: Overall tone of the intervention: deterrent (legal consequences), therapeutic (help exists), or mixed.

helpServices.description: Help services to show for the configured country.

messageBlocks.description: Message blocks to display, filtered for the configured language and tone.
